description: List a project's media assets (image/video/audio) with their URLs. Optionally filter by asset_type. Returns up to 20 with a total count. NOTE: asset URLs are on media.andresmarder.com, whose CDN WAF blocks some non-browser User-Agents (e.g. curl's default → 403). Prefer a browser User-Agent, or hand the URL to the user rather than fetching it server-side.

preview.description: Attach the pictures themselves, downscaled to 512px — and note that this is the ONLY way to see them from here: the asset URLs sit behind a CDN WAF that answers a non-browser User-Agent with 403, so fetching them yourself fails. The worker fetches with a browser UA. At most 4 per call; audio and video rows carry no picture and are named in preview.notes.

name: lab_list_assets
title: List Assets
